allowed_headline: Current evidence supports targeted acupuncture-outcome and physiology research, but does not establish the twelve meridians as an independently identified anatomical system; MRST is a falsifiable protocol to test residual specificity.
required_boundaries: Do not characterize the MRST as performed.
Do not present a clinical recommendation.
Do not claim that an interstitial-space interpretation proves meridians.
Do not infer human treatment benefit from animal mechanism studies.
Retain the abstention state and the independent-replication requirement.
